runtimes.value: mlx-audio (mlx-community/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-8bit; server truncation of long audio fixed in #1008); llama.cpp mtmd (ggml-org/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-GGUF, Metal); transformers native since 26.06.2026 but via the separate Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-hf repo; official qwen-asr package, transformers backend on MPS (sdpa: clips > 8 s get full attention, issue #213 open). vLLM backend is CUDA-oriented
runtimes.source: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR (README, issue #213); https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio (README, #1008); https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/multimodal.md; transformers docs model_doc/qwen3_asr
runtimes.note: Issue #213 does not name MPS explicitly, but sdpa is what MPS uses because flash-attn is CUDA-only, so it applies on a Mac. qwen-asr on MPS and llama.cpp on Metal are not backed by any Mac user report found. vLLM on Mac (vllm-metal) does not list Qwen3-ASR.

web.summary: Strong Whisper replacement on MLX; split long files into chunks; check French punctuation.
web.verdict: Better than Whisper on MLX; French punctuation lost on long audio; split long files

comments.text: **French**: punctuation lost on long audio, giving large blocks of unstructured text ([QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR#100, 25.02.2026](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/issues/100)).
mlx-audio server truncated long audio (`max_tokens=1024`), now fixed ([mlx-audio#1008, 09.10.2026](https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio/issues/1008)).
With MLX on macOS, copes much better with background noise than Whisper or Parakeet ([sidclaw, 29.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49100131)).

Satisfied with transcription quality and speed; better than Parakeet ([skolos, 08.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50013705)); better than Voxtral ([jiehong, 28.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50280418)).
